note: Rejudged 2026-11-08 after 14d3df65a7 against RFC 1332 Section 2.1 "Before any IP packets may be communicated, PPP must reach the Network-Layer Protocol phase, and the IP Control Protocol must reach the Opened state." Network-phase clause: TestNCPHeldUntilNetworkPhase/ipv4 holds CHAP pending 3 s; onlyChallengesUntil fails on any frame but a CHAP Challenge (Code 1) with a changed Identifier (RFC 1994 4.1 retransmission), so any IPCP 0x8021 or IP frame fails it; it also asserts no EventIPRequest and no AddAddressP2P (-); runAuthPhase revert recorded. Tightened window isolates the rule better than the old one. Opened clause, units unchanged: TestIPCPNoAddressBeforeOpened holds IPCP at Ack-Rcvd and fails on EventSessionIPAssigned, any AddAddressP2P or SetAdminUp (-, mutant ncp.go handleNCPPacket NewState == Opened -> != recorded); TestIPResponseConfiguresInterface installs ppp42 10.0.0.1/32 peer 10.0.0.2/32 and brings it up after Opened (+, sendIPAssigned revert recorded). Receive side: TestRFC1661NetworkLayerPacketDiscardedBeforeNCPOpened under RFC1661-3.6-2.
